name: Lauchheim (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of white, green and white, charged above the centre with the city arms of Lauchheim (a Teutonic cross on white under a mural crown).
history: Municipal flag of Lauchheim; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Lauchheim arms — cross with mural crown
